description: Policy for Script Supervisor continuity guard operations

rules.name: block_fake_operator_decisions
rules.description: Block any pipeline if fake operator decision detected

rules.name: block_production_accepted_without_operator
rules.description: Block if production_accepted is true without explicit operator gate

rules.name: block_duplicate_static_frames
rules.description: Block if preview has duplicate/static frames indicating failure

rules.name: require_operator_visual_review
rules.description: Require operator visual review before assembly

rules.name: block_voice_assembly_without_visual_approval
rules.description: Block voice generation and assembly without visual approval

rules.name: technical_pass_not_visual_pass
rules.description: Technical QA pass does not equal visual pass
